bio: My name is Paulina Alford and I am a Ruby on Rails developer since 2016.

I started my career in small Software Houses where I was building Web Applications as a Fullstack developer, with VanillaJS and jQuery on the frontend, later transitioning to React. During that time I delivered over 20 web applications. Our team was the first one in Poland to implement and customize Decidim - an open-source participatory platform that allows citizens to discuss initiatives and vote on budgets in their cities.

Later in my career, I worked for bigger companies on their flagship products and internal tools. I learned there a lot about scaling, optimization for hundreds of thousands of users and leadership. I have a lot of experience with working with external APIs like payment providers (Stripe, Adyen, Mollie), Google Calendar, Salesforce etc.
I don't shy away from taking ownership of the product. I love learning from my teammates and always help them when they need it.
I believe that if you put focus into your work, you can create an amazing product, but doing it with great people will let you make it exceptional.
